description: Upgrade plan to migrate the Java application to the latest LTS versions

tasks.description: Upgrade the application to Java 25 and Spring Boot 4.x
tasks.reason: Adopt the latest stable LTS Java release and compatible Spring platform versions for long-term support.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade Java to 25, Spring Boot to 4.x, Spring Framework to 7.x, and migrate Java EE javax.* namespaces to Jakarta EE jakarta.* namespaces where required. Preserve application behavior and update build configuration, dependencies, source code, and tests for compatibility.
tasks.taskSummary: Successfully upgraded PhotoAlbum-Java from Java 8 + Spring Boot 2.7.18 to Java 25 + Spring Boot 4.0.0 with Spring Framework 7.x. All code migrated to Jakarta EE namespaces, Spring Security updated to modern lambda DSL, 2 critical CVEs fixed, and 100% unit test pass rate achieved.
